# Atomic chess refutation book — Black's first replies

Human-readable rendering of the plan4 density-screen artifact (report4 §1 expanded): every cheap forced win against a second move at the start position, with its principal variation and search-node cost.

**Provenance.** Source data: `docs/plans/solve/measurements/plan4/state/p2_*.json` (400 runs, 8 s screen, `--first-outcome`, release build at report4's recorded commit); generated by `docs/plans/solve/measurements/plan10/make_book.py` (plan10 task 4), which verifies the counts against report4 §1 before writing.

**Reading.** Moves are given in long algebraic (UCI squares, origin-target; `=` marks promotion). Each line is a full principal variation from the start position: White's first move, Black's reply, then White's forced win (all 55 refutations are White wins; outcome + PV as returned by the solver). `nodes` is the search cost at which the win was proven (screen budget 8 s).

**Scope caveat (report4 §2/§3).** This book is the measured, saturated cheap class — one-sided and patterned (queen–bishop diagonals only). The remaining 345 ply-2 positions and all 20 ply-1 positions are the quiet plateau class (promotion sample: still censored at 120 s, ~20–23.5M nodes); the book is self-contained at startpos and does not reach the ladder's deep tactical wins.
